verdict.rationale: Shopify's own help docs list a page titled "Collecting tips with the Shopify POS," so tipping is a documented first-party capability. The pack gives only that title and no details on how tipping is configured or where tips are collected. Missing for 10: configurable percentage presets, smart tip amounts, custom tip entry, tip prompts shown on the card reader or terminal, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
